verdicts.reason: A has lost the headline, URL and 'HO SMART' wordmark entirely. What's left is an empty floating blue parallelogram, a tiny squashed photo strip and a white logo outline that disappears on the white canvas, so it's unusable. B also drops all text (headline, URL, brand name) and leaves a big dead white band in the middle. Still, it keeps a recognisable blue header with the logo and an intact phone photo, though the white diagonal stripes spill awkwardly over the photo's left edge. That makes B the less broken of the two.
